keySentence: A brave child spoke up loudly.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The child was brave. People agreed with him. The truth was out. A brave child spoke up loudly.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The brave child's voice echoed through the street. A brave child spoke up loudly and everyone heard. People started nodding and repeating the same words. The emperor's face turned red with embarrassment. He realized everyone had been lying to him all along. The swindlers had already run away with the gold.
